title: Zambia Is Done for Now With Taking Over Mining Companies - Bloomberg
主要内容: Zambia has clarified that it is not planning to take over more mining companies or nationalize the industry, according to Finance Minister Bwalya Ng’andu. The government has already acquired Glencore Plc’s and Vedanta Ltd.’s local operations in the past two years. However, remarks by President Edgar Lungu in December, where he mentioned the desire to take 'significant stakes' in unspecified mines, raised concerns about a potential new wave of nationalization. Despite these comments, the government has not indicated any further plans to expand its control over the mining sector.
